name: EUR/USD OLS Fair-Value Mean Reversion
description: Mean-reversion strategy on EUR/USD driven by the US–Germany 10Y yield spread. Uses rolling OLS (252-day) to model fair value from the rate differential. Enters long when the deviation z-score crosses below −2σ (undervalued), exits when z-score reverts above 0 (fair value). 100% equity allocation, long-only, one position at a time.
source:
# EUR/USD OLS Fair-Value Mean Reversion Strategy
# ============================================================================
# Model: Rolling OLS regression of EUR/USD close on the US–Germany 10Y spread
# Entry: Long when deviation z-score crosses below −2.0 (undervalued)
# Exit:  Close when z-score crosses back above 0.0 (fair value reversion)
# Sizing: 100% equity per trade, long-only, no pyramiding
# ============================================================================

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Macro Data: 10Y Government Bond Yields ---
# US 10Y Treasury yield (daily, FRED)
us10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id="DGS10", use_alfred=False)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_src.result)

# Germany 10Y yield (monthly, FRED — OECD Long-Term Interest Rate)
de10y_src = economic_indicators(series_id="IRLTLT01DEM156N")()
de10y = ffill(de10y_src.result)

# Yield spread: US 10Y minus Germany 10Y
eurusd_spread = us10y - de10y

# --- Rolling OLS Fair-Value Model (252-day window) ---
ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=eurusd_spread, y=close)
fair_value = ols.intercept + ols.slope * eurusd_spread

# Deviation from fair value
deviation = close - fair_value

# Z-score of deviation (252-day rolling window)
dev_zscore = zscore(window=252)(deviation)

# --- Entry / Exit Signals ---
# Long entry: z-score crosses below −2.0 (EUR/USD undervalued vs model)
entry_signal = crossunder(dev_zscore, -2.0)

# Exit: z-score crosses back above 0.0 (reverted to fair value)
exit_signal = crossover(dev_zscore, 0.0)

# Hold position from entry until exit fires
held_long = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Deviation in pips (1 pip = 0.0001 for EUR/USD) ---
deviation_pips = deviation * 10000

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# --- Event Markers ---

# Entry marker: z-score crossunder −2σ
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Entry (Z < -2σ)",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Deviation (pips)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
        ColumnSpec(title="Fair Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(dev_zscore, deviation_pips, close, fair_value, entry_signal)

# Exit marker: z-score crossover 0
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Exit (Z > 0, Fair Value Reversion)",
    icon=Icon.CheckCircleIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
        ColumnSpec(title="Fair Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(dev_zscore, close, fair_value, exit_signal)
